subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In social studies class, students learned that countries sometimes make agreements to protect parts of the ocean beyond…”?
options: Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance.
The teacher explained that no single country owns all oceans, but many countries use them.
The teacher explained that borders can change because of wars, agreements, independence movements, and political decisions.
The teacher explained that studying history does not mean feeling smarter than the past.
